about: Magellanic Cloud Ltd is a technology group operating through subsidiaries across IT/ITES, AI-enabled e-surveillance and drones/UAVs. Motivity Labs and JNIT provide digital engineering and staffing; IVIS/Provigil deliver surveillance platforms, monitoring and systems integration; Scandron develops drones, while Finoux adds fintech capabilities. The group serves enterprises and public-infrastructure customers in India
